From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: auditório and aŭditorio

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Internationalism (see English auditorium), ultimately from Latin audītōrium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈɑu̯ditorio/, [ˈɑ̝u̯diˌt̪o̞rio̞]
  • Rhymes: -orio
  • Syllabification(key): au‧di‧to‧ri‧o
  • Hyphenation(key): au‧di‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

auditorio

  1. auditorium (large room for public meetings or performances)
  2. lecture theatre, auditorium (similar room for giving lectures, especially one with pitched floor)

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin auditōrium.

Pronunciation

[edit]

IPA(key): /aw.diˈtɔ.rjo/

Noun

[edit]

auditorio m (plural auditori)

  1. auditorium

Further reading

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin auditorium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /audiˈtoɾjo/ [au̯.ð̞iˈt̪o.ɾjo]
  • Rhymes: -oɾjo
  • Syllabification: au‧di‧to‧rio

Noun

[edit]

auditorio m (plural auditorios)

  1. audience
  2. auditorium
    Synonym: auditórium

Further reading

[edit]
  • “auditorio”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
